versions.content: CEMR on SR interface for DID s with no CEMR in the UDS re- quest If the IOC DID has no CEMR in the UDS request message, the Dcm shall use a Dcm_Cemr_Type that has a bit for each DcmDspData of the DID on the interface IOControlRequest that has each bit set to 1.
